title: Preserve versioned feedback identity and retry semantics across both modes
description:
PLANNING ONLY. Ryan requested filing and design before implementation. This issue is not authorization to build runtime features, deploy, change cloud permissions, publish packages, push, or migrate production data. Keep open pending design review and separate implementation authorization.

As a editor, I want auditable version-pinned decisions and explicit feedback acknowledgements, so that corrections and retries cannot mislabel a changed output or duplicate learning.

Feature: Versioned feedback contract
  Scenario: Correct an explicit human label
    Given a reviewed item and an identified classifier/prediction revision
    When an authorized editor corrects that output's label and explanation
    Then the prior feedback remains auditable and the correction identifies its target revision
    And sibling outputs receive no implicit feedback
  Scenario: Retry after an uncertain acknowledgement
    Given a feedback request whose acknowledgement was lost
    When the client retries the same request identity
    Then the client can determine its accepted, rejected or pending outcome
    And the authoritative owner records no duplicate feedback or learning transition
  Scenario: Review an old prediction after a classifier change
    Given the classifier definition or publication binding changed after prediction
    When feedback for the older prediction arrives
    Then history retains the old revision and an explicit reviewed policy governs reuse
    And feedback is not silently applied to a different question or output

Design review / future Definition of Done: review these observable acceptance cases with the shared contract; executable specs and implementation are future work after authorization.
Open: version envelope and stale-review policy, acknowledgement/status API, idempotency scope/retention, correction/retraction semantics and mode conformance. Reuse definition-version and SDK history work.

Preserve optional curated-example priming (decision-flywheel-da886c09-7acb-45d3-acf8-c81585f26d8a), its preview/revision/explicit-label acceptance contract, and separate existing scholarly research-paper and web-summary transformations. Priming must never become an onboarding gate. Common input items are distinct from publication-specific decisions; one publication accepting an item must never implicitly label another output.

comments.text: Recovery checkpoint: M1 reboot caused exec-server loss, not source checkpoint loss. Core follow-on 3ed844b and Papyrus 15b4426 survived. Release-blocking archive capacity issue is now fixed in ecc55eb: prospective record/count/byte budgets checked before write; unchanged content-addressed retries do not rewrite native records; steering checks intent plus bounded completion capacity before dispatch, with configurable max_result_bytes default 64000 (overall contract bound 2 MB). Insufficient count/bytes causes zero evaluator calls and no pending publication. Existing single-owner lock remains required; this is not distributed CAS or a new storage adapter. After reboot ran only lightweight single-process checks with BLAS/OMP threads 1: 13 record/steering tests pass, plus 9 embedded/HTTP composition tests; no heavy native/container build, full suite restart, server restart or unrelated process termination. Pre-reboot evidence: 58 core focused tests, four Papyrus curation-to-mode integration tests, SSR/payload checks, TypeScript and lint. Follow-on adds actual scoped native trial/evaluated promotion, immutable source+binding+prediction joins, source-correct scoped replay into a fresh SDK, old-context read-only UI and retraction reconciliation. Owner CatalogStorage checkpoint 45f8ee15 interoperated in a temporary read-only-source check. Runtime-specific historical learning still fails closed for changed labeled sources; global review-rate override is not publication steering. Storage/runtime conversion, public owner-lock composition, coordinator decision and verified auth/route wiring remain pending before hosted activation. No live/paid classifier evidence, new resources, IAM/OAuth changes or deployment. Both initiatives remain in progress; ready source handoff is core 3ed844b + ecc55eb and Papyrus 15b4426, based on prior 1cbe194/c471eb7.
